create_unary_unary_rpc: create a UnaryUnaryMultiCallable for a unary-unary RPC method on an async gRPC channel
create_unary_stream_rpc: create a UnaryStreamMultiCallable for a unary-stream RPC method on an async gRPC channel
create_stream_unary_rpc: create a StreamUnaryMultiCallable for a stream-unary RPC method on an async gRPC channel
create_stream_stream_rpc: create a StreamStreamMultiCallable for a bidirectional streaming RPC method on an async gRPC channel
close_async_channel: close an async gRPC channel and release all resources with an optional grace period
